content:
Hi everyone,

I've been working away on putting Quantum Mechanics into Lean it's got a bit out of hand, 438 files now, and have got a lot of enjoyment out of it.

If anyone else is interested in this topic the GitHub repository is here:
https://github.com/zblore/csd-lean4

Some key points it covers: Projective Geometry and measure theory, The Born Rule & Measurement dynamics

If you fancy having a look i've created a set of pathways here:
https://github.com/zblore/csd-lean4/blob/main/docs/PATHS.md

Alternatively, if you are Mathlib inclined i'd LOVE you to have a look and some extensions I may propose to the Mathlib library at some point if I can get up the courage here:
https://github.com/zblore/csd-lean4/blob/main/MATHLIB-GAPS.md

Anyway, hope someone else finds this interesting.
This topic was moved here from #Project announcements > CSD-Lean4: Deterministic geometric Quantum Mechanics by Michael Rothgang.
